title: A TQFT from Quantum Teichmüller Theory
note: Commun. Math. Phys. 330(3) (2014), 887-934; arXiv:1109.6295. Primary construction of the Andersen-Kashaev state-integral TQFT from Faddeev's noncompact quantum dilogarithm on ideally triangulated 3-manifolds (bean qou-exr5; see dusenbury2025 for an expository MS-thesis account).
